papers.title_in_file: The Grand Challenge of Quantum Applications
papers.version_note: arXiv:2511.09124v3, dated December 5, 2025 (text layer shows 4 Dec 2025).
papers.what_it_is: A perspective from Google Quantum AI proposing a five-stage framework for quantum applications research and arguing that Stages II and III are the most under-resourced bottlenecks.

existing.note: The paper numbers its stages I to V in the text list, but Figure 1 and the stage summaries also define a Stage 0 (fundamental research) that the authors set aside and do not discuss further.
existing.value: The authors propose a five-stage framework (Stages I to V) for quantum applications research, from discovery of new algorithms in an abstract setting to application deployment; they also define a Stage 0 of fundamental research that they do not discuss further.
existing.anchor: Introduction p.1; The five stages p.3
quotes: We divide that quest into five stages:
1. Discovery of new quantum algorithms in an abstract setting.
5. Application deployment.
Stage 0 research is typically abstract, curiosity-driven, and conducted primarily within academia rather than industrial groups.
existing.certainty_reason: Authors' own claim, not tested in the paper.
